teaser.en: Squeeze a ripe one and it puffs out brown dust: to the Digo, a hyena's tobacco.
teaser.sw: Ukiubana ulioiva hutoa vumbi la kahawia: kwa Wadigo, ni tumbaku ya fisi.
teaser.dg: Uchiminya iriyoivwa, inalavya vumbi ra rangi ya dongo: kpwa Adigo, ni tumbaku ya fisi.

summary.en: Tumbaku ya fisi are puffballs, round fungi with no cap or gills that release clouds of brown spores when ripe. The Digo do not count them as true mushrooms.
summary.sw: Tumbaku ya fisi ni kuvu za mviringo zisizo na kofia wala matamvua, ambazo zikiiva hutoa wingu la vijimbegu vya kahawia (kwa Kiingereza *puffballs*). Wadigo hawazihesabu kuwa uyoga halisi.
summary.dg: *Tumbaku ya fisi* ni *puffballs*: ni ya mviringo, taina kofiya wala miraba, na ichiivwa inalavya vumbi ra rangi ya dongo (*spores*) dza mosi. Adigo taaitala kukala ni uoga wa kpweli.

about.en: Puffballs are round or pear-shaped fungi that sit on the ground without a cap or gills. Young ones are white and solid inside. As they ripen the inside turns into a mass of olive-brown powder, and the skin either opens at a small hole on top or cracks apart. A tap or a raindrop sends out a puff of spores like smoke.
about.sw: Kuvu hizi (*puffballs*) ni za mviringo au umbo la peasi, na hukaa ardhini bila kofia wala matamvua. Zikiwa changa huwa nyeupe na ngumu ndani. Zinapoiva, ndani hugeuka kuwa unga mwingi wa rangi ya kahawia-zeituni, na ngozi ama hufunguka kwa tundu dogo juu au hupasuka. Kuguswa kidogo au tone la mvua hutoa mpulizo wa vijimbegu kama moshi.
about.dg: *Tumbaku ya fisi* ni ya mviringo au ya umbo dza pera, na inakala photsi bila kofiya wala miraba. Ichikala ichere ndide, ndani ni nyereru na ngumu. Ichiivwa, ndani kunagaluka kukala unga wa rangi ya dongo na chijani, na gadaye ama inavuguka kpwa tundu ridide dzulu, ama inaahuka. Uchiiguta chidide, au tone ra mvula richiigbwera, inalavya vumbi dza mosi.

where.en: Puffballs grow on the ground in grassland, woodland and old fields, often after rain.
where.sw: Kuvu hizi huota ardhini katika nyika, misitu na mashamba ya zamani, mara nyingi baada ya mvua.
where.dg: *Tumbaku ya fisi* inamera photsi phatu phenye nyasi, phatu phenye mihi na kpwenye minda ya kare, mara nyinji bada ya mvula.

culture.en: The Digo word *uoga* means the fleshy, edible mushrooms. Pakia found that puffballs, earth stars and the bracket fungi on tree trunks are not counted as true *uoga* and are not put in any other category either.
culture.sw: Neno la Kidigo *uoga* linamaanisha uyoga wenye nyama unaolika. Pakia aligundua kuwa kuvu hizi, kuvu-nyota (*earth stars*) na kuvu-rafu zinazoota kwenye vigogo vya miti hazihesabiwi kuwa *uoga* halisi, na wala haziwekwi katika kundi jingine lolote.
culture.dg: Kpwa Chidigo, neno *uoga* rina mana ya uoga wenye nyama, unaoriwa. Pakia waona kukala *tumbaku ya fisi*, *earth stars* na *dzogalele* (*bracket fungi*) zinazomera dzulu ya makolo ga mihi, tavitalwa kukala ni *uoga* wa kpweli, na piya taviikpwa kahi ya fungu ranjina.

names.en: Pakia records *tumbaku ya fisi* for the puffballs. In the Mgombato dictionary *tumbaku* is 'tobacco' or 'snuff' and *fisi* is 'hyena', so the name reads 'hyena's tobacco', perhaps after the snuff-like puff of spores.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *tumbaku ya fisi* kwa kuvu hizi. Katika kamusi ya Mgombato, *tumbaku* ni 'tumbaku' au 'ugoro' na *fisi* ni 'fisi', kwa hiyo jina hili linasomeka 'tumbaku ya fisi', pengine kwa sababu ya mpulizo wa vijimbegu unaofanana na ugoro.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *tumbaku ya fisi* kpwa *puffballs*. Kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, *tumbaku* ni tumbaku ya kunusa au ya kuvuta, na *fisi* ni nyama wa weruni (*hyena*), kpwa hivyo dzina rina mana ya 'tumbaku ya fisi', chahi kpwa sababu vumbi rinarolavya rinahalana na tumbaku ya kunusa.
